name: Brunswick Chiropractic Center of New Jersey - Neil Kosin, DC
what_they_do: Chiropractic practice run by brothers Dr. Neil Kosin and Dr. Ivan Kosin at 1594 Route 130, Suite 2, with a second office in Edison (976 Inman Ave). Treats back/neck pain, headaches, sciatica, carpal tunnel and sports strains, and offers Triton spinal decompression therapy, foot orthotics, DOT medical exams and personal-injury/auto-accident care.
customers: Local pain and injury patients in North Brunswick and Edison, auto-accident claimants (they publish a PIP intake form), and commercial drivers needing DOT exams.

size_signals.signal: Two doctors (brothers Neil and Ivan Kosin) and two offices - North Brunswick opened 2011, Edison expanded 2022
Google rating of 5.0 at the 1594 US-130 address
Offers online bill payment, a DOT exam form and separate auto-accident intake - multiple revenue lines with dedicated paperwork

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: 'MORE DETAILS' hero button and 'CALL NOW' blocks near the footer; no book-online button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No booking and no web form at all - patients must call (908) 753-5454 / (732) 409-7774 or download PDFs and bring them in.
website_review.trust_signals: Two-doctor bios with personal stories, 5.0 Google rating (not shown on site), patient testimonials, decompression technology page, free posture exam and free orthotics scan offers, online payment
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer copyright says 2024; the newest 'News & Updates' post is from 2022 with several from 2019; contact emails are @aol.com and @optonline.net; photos of the doctors are missing from the home page; office hours are not published anywhere on the site
website_review.search_basics: Title is only 'Home - Brunswick Chiropractic Center of NJ' with no town or service; no meta description; only decompression and orthotics have dedicated pages; no hours, no schema beyond WebPage/Breadcrumb/WebSite
top_issues: No hours anywhere and no LocalBusiness schema - an assistant cannot answer 'are you open tonight'
No web form or online booking; PDF patient forms only
Stale site: 2024 copyright and 2019/2022 blog posts

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is fully open (User-Agent: * / Disallow:) so OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot are allowed, and the GBP shows category and hours; but the site's own title omits the town and service. Answerable: addresses and phone numbers are text, yet opening hours are absent from the site entirely, prices are never stated, and JSON-LD only declares WebPage, WebSite and BreadcrumbList - no LocalBusiness/Chiropractor node. Bookable: zero - the only paths are a phone call or downloading PDFs (new patient, auto-accident PIP, DOT exam).

operations_signals.signal: Patient intake is three separate PDFs (new patient, auto accident PIP, DOT exam) that staff must print or key in
Two offices share the same two phone numbers and the same generic email addresses, so call routing is manual
Auto-accident/PIP work implies insurance correspondence, liens and progress reports - document-heavy admin

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish hours, per-office service details and price ranges in text and add LocalBusiness/Chiropractor JSON-LD for both offices - the site currently states no hours at all
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page footer lists addresses and two phones but no hours; JSON-LD types are only WebPage/WebSite/BreadcrumbList

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online scheduling plus digital intake to replace the three PDF forms, with separate flows for auto-accident and DOT patients
top_opportunities.evidence: 'Download these documents to save time at our office' with PDF links for new patient, PIP and DOT forms; no form element on the page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Refresh the site: 2024 copyright, 2019-2022 blog content, no doctor photos, and no click-to-call or book button in the mobile first screen
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone screenshot at 390px shows a full-bleed spine photo, 'MORE DETAILS' button and a hamburger only - no phone number above the fold

scores.reasons: Gap: no hours, no schema, no form, no booking and a 2024 copyright on an otherwise decent-looking site. Pay: two-doctor, two-office practice with PIP and DOT revenue, but consumer chiropractic ticket sizes. Ease: hours, schema and a scheduling widget are quick, well-scoped work. Evidence: read home page fully, robots.txt, mobile screenshot and the Google profile.
